## Appearance

Diana is a very pretty girl with black eyes, rosy cheeks, and black hair that hangs in long, glossy curls. She has a merry expression, a plump figure with dimples, and a smooth, fair complexion. She dresses stylishly and takes good care of her appearance.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P22](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0022), [v1 c15 P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022), [v1 c29 P38](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0038), [v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 c33 P9](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0009), [v1 c33 P13](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0013), [v1 c33 P14](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0014)_

## Personality

Diana is a pleasant, practical, and good-natured girl with a cheerful disposition and a penchant for laughter. Though less imaginative than her closest friend, she is loyal, affectionate, and deeply devoted to those she loves. She enjoys reading, playing games, and simple country pastimes, though she can be easily frightened by eerie or spooky stories. While generally obedient to her strict mother, she possesses a warm, forgiving heart and a practical outlook on life.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P26](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0026), [v1 c15 P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 c17 P5](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0005), [v1 c20 P9](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0009), [v1 c21 P17](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0017), [v1 c26 P9](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0009), [v2 c2 P9](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0009), [v2 c4 P20](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0020), [v2 c26 P60](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0060)_

## History

Diana Barry grew up as the daughter of George Barry at Orchard Slope in Avonlea. Shortly after Anne Shirley arrived at Green Gables, the two girls met and instantly became bosom friends, swearing an oath of eternal devotion. They spent their childhood exploring the nearby woods and fields, founding a Story Club, and sharing their secrets. Diana attended Avonlea school alongside Anne and participated in local events, including the Avonlea Debating Club concert. After accidentally becoming intoxicated on Marilla's currant wine during a tea party, she was temporarily forbidden by her mother from playing with Anne, but they were reconciled after Anne saved Diana's younger sister Minnie May during a severe attack of croup. In their late teens, Diana joined the Avonlea Village Improvement Society and helped canvass the community for local causes. Though she did not attend college like Anne, she remained her most loyal companion in Avonlea. She eventually fell in love with Fred Wright, and the two became engaged and married in an old-fashioned summer ceremony at Orchard Slope. The couple settled on a farm in Avonlea, where Diana gave birth to her first child, a son named Fred.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P62](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0062), [v1 c12 P23](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0023), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c16 P22](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0022), [v1 c16 P42](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0042), [v1 c18 P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 c18 P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043), [v1 c19 P34](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0034), [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v2 c6 P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008), [v2 c29 P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011), [v2 c29 P15](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0015), [v3 c29 P0](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0000), [v3 c29 P6](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0006), [v3 c39 P42](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0042)_
